render_prompt_template: create a Prompt object with a Jinja2 template string and render it with keyword arguments
get_prompt_by_name: load a named prompt template from prompt_library.json and render it with provided keyword arguments
validate_required_args: review the Prompt class prompt_render method to validate all required args are present before rendering
build_prompt_class: build a Prompt class instance with a name, template string, description, and list of required args
load_prompt_library: summarize the get_prompt function that loads prompt templates from a JSON file and renders by name
